question: Only the 3 cPTIO libraries are new; the -N and +NO3- controls are Ravazzolo2020’s.
proposed_answer: Contrasts for this study borrow Ravazzolo2020_minusN_R1-3 and Ravazzolo2020_NO3_R1-3 (other_factor_level for them = no inhibitor). Its own valid N contrast is +NO3- vs -N, which belongs to Ravazzolo2020 (don’t duplicate it); cPTIO samples serve the +NO3-+cPTIO vs +NO3- inhibitor contrast.
evidence: PMC8431222 Methods 4.2 (’Datasets corresponding to -N and +NO3- treatments were already analyzed ... in a previous work’); accessions_resolved.tsv.

question: The paper kept only two of the three +NO3- + cPTIO replicates after QC; GEO deposits all three and doesn’t say which was dropped.
proposed_answer: Keep all 3 included for now; identify the outlier from Table S6 (in the paper’s supplementary zip) or our own QC, then set include FALSE for it.
evidence: PMC8431222 Methods 4.3 (’only two biological replicates were kept for the +NO3- + cPTIO treatment’).

question: The cPTIO libraries were deposited 16 months after the controls (GEO Apr 2021 vs Dec 2019) and GSE173102 lists ’TruSeq Stranded’ while GSE141860 lists ’TruSeq RNA’. The paper presents one experiment but doesn’t give sequencing dates.
proposed_answer: Treat as possible batch confounding between cPTIO and the borrowed controls; flag on any cPTIO contrast.
evidence: GEO GSE141860/GSE173102 submission dates and extract protocols; PMC8431222 Methods 4.1-4.2.
